en.title: Preliminary Enforcement Brief: Potential Unauthorized Pond Filling in Wetland Conservation Area (DB-0002)
en.summary: Remote sensing detection indicates potential pond filling or ground disturbance across 0.85 ha within the Wetland Conservation Area (WCA). Changes in NDWI (-0.22) and radar backscatter (+4.2 dB) observed on 2025-05-02 suggest loss of open water surface and alteration of site topography, potentially conflicting with statutory planning intentions for fish pond conservation.
evidence: Affected area estimated at 0.85 hectares within the Wetland Conservation Area (WCA).
Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) delta of -0.22 indicates loss of open surface water.
Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) backscatter increase of 4.2 dB indicates surface roughness changes consistent with earth filling or structural disturbance.
statutory_basis: Town Planning Board Guidelines (TPB PG-No. 12C), Section 6.1: The planning intention of the WCA is to conserve the ecological value of fish ponds.

Town Planning Board Guidelines (TPB PG-No. 12C), Section 6.1: New development within the WCA is not permitted unless supporting conservation or serving as an essential infrastructure project with overriding public interest.
Town Planning Board Guidelines (TPB PG-No. 12C), Section 6.1: Wetland compensation and planning permission are required for any development involving pond filling.
en.recommended_action: Conduct an urgent on-site inspection to verify the nature of ground works, check planning register records for valid planning permission under Section 16 of the Town Planning Ordinance, and issue a statutory notice if unauthorized pond filling is confirmed.
en.limitations: Findings are based on satellite radar and optical spectral analysis without ground truthing. Cadastral boundary verification and field inspection are required to confirm precise land status and actual on-site activities.

zh_hant.title: 初步執法摘要：濕地保育區內疑似未經授權填塘工程（DB-0002）
zh_hant.summary: 遙感監測顯示濕地保育區（WCA）內約0.85公頃土地可能存在填塘或地面擾動情況。2025年5月2日錄得之歸一化水體指數變化（-0.22）及雷達後向散射變化（+4.2 dB）顯示水面消失及地表粗糙度改變，可能違反魚塘保育的法定規劃意向。
evidence: 受影響面積估算為0.85公頃，位於濕地保育區（WCA）界線內。
歸一化水體指數（NDWI）下降0.22，顯示開闊水體流失。
雷達後向散射增加4.2 dB，符合填土或地形受擾動之特徵。
最初偵測日期為2025年5月2日。
statutory_basis: 城市規劃委員會規劃指引編號12C第6.1段：濕地保育區的規劃意向是保育魚塘的生態價值。
城市規劃委員會規劃指引編號12C第6.1段：除非為支援該區生態價值保育或具壓倒性公眾利益之必要基建，否則濕地保育區內不容許新發展。
城市規劃委員會規劃指引編號12C第6.1段：任何涉及填塘的發展均須進行濕地補償，並須取得規劃許可。
zh_hant.recommended_action: 儘速安排實地督察以核實地面工程性質，查核規劃許可名冊是否涵蓋該地段，如證實涉及違例填塘應採取進一步法定執行管制行動。
zh_hant.limitations: 本分析基於衛星雷達及光學頻譜遙感數據，尚未進行地面實地核證。須覆核地段界線及展開實地調查以確定確切土地現況。

citations.document_title: Town Planning Board Guidelines for Application for Developments within Deep Bay Area (TPB PG-No. 12C)
citations.verbatim_quote: Wetland compensation is required for any development involving pond filling and mitigation measures against disturbance would be necessary. They would be imposed as part of the planning approval conditions.
